rule: **Existing tools work.** Type checkers work through `.d.vibe.ts` (VIP-27), and linters, Knip, bundlers and test runners each read `.vibe`.
errorPattern: declaration outputs differ from the \.ts twin: services\.d\.mts against internal/system\.d\.mts, services\.d\.mts
reason: A bundled build that names internal/system.vibe as an entry emits internal/system.mjs with no declaration; the .ts twin emits internal/system.d.mts. A published package carries JavaScript and ordinary .d.ts files.
